description: The flagship national 36-hour data science and AI hackathon bringing together over 500+ student innovators to build production-ready ML systems, agentic workflows, and predictive analytics tools.

title: Mastering LLMs & RAG Architectures
location: Seminar Hall 2, Data Science Dept, VIT Pune
description: A hands-on, code-first masterclass exploring Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector embeddings with Milvus/Pinecone, and building autonomous agentic tool loops using modern open-weights models.

title: Computer Vision & Edge AI Bootcamp
location: Virtual via Google Meet & Discord Live
description: A comprehensive one-day deep dive into real-time object detection with YOLOv11, TensorRT quantization, and deploying optimized models on low-power edge hardware like Raspberry Pi and Jetson Nano.

title: Data Engineering at Scale: Kafka & Spark
description: Industry deep dive into building fault-tolerant distributed streaming pipelines, lakehouse architectures with Apache Iceberg, and processing millions of telemetry events in real-time.

title: Algorithmic Trading & Quantitative Finance
description: Explore stochastic calculus, backtesting trading strategies using Python, volatility modeling with GARCH, and machine learning architectures applied to high-frequency market microstructure.
